S.FORM: lalu likuy qu Hoku. smru moyay kakay hkangi nqu qara qhuniq.yasa son ta "hoku". ita tayal hiya ga,sswe balay mlikuy lahang ngasal ru blaq p'aras posa bnkis.sswe balay laqi ga stman balay na bnkis.yani yaqih gaya stama balay hoku ru.pcingan laqi likuy sllwan yaya yayba "Hoku". sinllwan naha lalu Hoku qani ga,kahul squ qalang M'rqwang ru bnkis na qutux naha niqan,swa naha sllwan maha Hoku qani ga,pucing balay na laqi mlikuy ru mosa baqun stama mnaga ni yaba kiy yaya ma,sraral hya ga maha ni baq mqyanux qu 'laqi cinngasal qani lga siqoris sa musa mtbuci mqyanux nanak kwara qu qbsuyan hya la,mosa nanak pyang cikuy na laqi qu msthay ngasal,nanu yasa qu imi na Hoku qani ga mosa blaq tun bnkis ru phaw miq squ qsya hlhun, ps'ru qnxan qutux ngasal.ana misuw qani ga baqun naha kwara qu sinllwan lalu na Hoku qani ppraw qnxan na bbnkis ma. Hoku maki qu Gaga na Tayal maha.Hoku qani ga pgleng maras rmaw inlungan nqu bnkis,yan nqu musa cinblihun smyey ga siki s'aras naha hoku,hoku qani ga siki maybnkis ru mr'ru qu inlungan nya giwan nqu pgleng kmayal zywaw na musa smyey ru pquziy squ tokan te syaw blihun teta baqun kwara ka qalang maha nyux rima wahan smyey ni squliq qu laqi kneril cinngasal qani lma. nyux galan hoku ni yutas qu Hoku qani gi hya qu p'aras lmosay. 阿公把Hoku當他的拐杖帶上帶下. siki maras ta hoku musa ta mklhngan mhkangi ay! gi ssagaw ta mqu. !
S.PHON: lalu likuj qu ħoku [s|ɕ]mru mojaj kakaj ħkaŋi nqu qara qħuniqja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]on ta ħoku ita tajal ħija ɣa[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]we βalaj mlikuj laħaŋ ŋa[s|ɕ]al ru βlaq pʔara[s|ɕ] po[s|ɕ]a βnki[s|ɕ][s|ɕ][s|ɕ]we βalaj laqi ɣa [s|ɕ]tman βalaj na βnki[s|ɕ]jani jaqiħ ɣaja [s|ɕ]tama βalaj ħoku rup[ʦ|ʨ]iŋan laqi likuj [s|ɕ]llwan jaja jajβa ħoku [s|ɕ]inllwan naħa lalu ħoku qani ɣakaħul [s|ɕ]qu qalaŋ mʔrqwaŋ ru βnki[s|ɕ] na qutux naħa niqan[s|ɕ]wa naħa [s|ɕ]llwan maħa ħoku qani ɣapu[ʦ|ʨ]iŋ βalaj na laqi mlikuj ru mo[s|ɕ]a βaqun [s|ɕ]tama mnaɣa ni jaβa kij jaja ma[s|ɕ]raral ħja ɣa maħa ni βaq mqjanux qu ʔlaqi [ʦ|ʨ]inŋa[s|ɕ]al qani lɣa [s|ɕ]iqori[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]a mu[s|ɕ]a mtβu[ʦ|ʨ]i mqjanux nanak kwara qu qβ[s|ɕ]ujan ħja lamo[s|ɕ]a nanak pjaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj na laqi qu m[s|ɕ]tħaj ŋa[s|ɕ]alnanu ja[s|ɕ]a qu imi na ħoku qani ɣa mo[s|ɕ]a βlaq tun βnki[s|ɕ] ru pħaw miq [s|ɕ]qu q[s|ɕ]ja ħlħun p[s|ɕ]ʔru qnxan qutux ŋa[s|ɕ]alana mi[s|ɕ]uw qani ɣa βaqun naħa kwara qu [s|ɕ]inllwan lalu na ħoku qani ppraw qnxan na ββnki[s|ɕ] ma ħoku maki qu ɣaɣa na tajal maħaħoku qani ɣa pɣleŋ mara[s|ɕ] rmaw inluŋan nqu βnki[s|ɕ]jan nqu mu[s|ɕ]a [ʦ|ʨ]inβliħun [s|ɕ]mjej ɣa [s|ɕ]iki [s|ɕ]ʔara[s|ɕ] naħa ħokuħoku qani ɣa [s|ɕ]iki majβnki[s|ɕ] ru mrʔru qu inluŋan nja ɣiwan nqu pɣleŋ kmajal zjwaw na mu[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]mjej ru pquzij [s|ɕ]qu tokan te [s|ɕ]jaw βliħun teta βaqun kwara ka qalaŋ maħa njux rima waħan [s|ɕ]mjej ni [s|ɕ]quliq qu laqi kneril [ʦ|ʨ]inŋa[s|ɕ]al qani lma njux ɣalan ħoku ni juta[s|ɕ] qu ħoku qani ɣi ħja qu pʔara[s|ɕ] lmo[s|ɕ]aj ***ħoku********* [s|ɕ]iki mara[s|ɕ] ta ħoku mu[s|ɕ]a ta mklħŋan mħkaŋi aj ɣi [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]aɣaw ta mqu
